title: Use HTTPS for Last.fm Audioscrobbler requests
problem: Liquidsoap sends Last.fm API requests to an HTTP default endpoint, which Last.fm rejects with error code 4 because HTTPS is required.
reproduce: Invoke audioscrobbler.submit with the default endpoint; authorization is sent to http://ws.audioscrobbler.com/2.0 and rejected.
acceptance: The default Audioscrobbler base URL is https://ws.audioscrobbler.com/2.0 and the insecure default is absent.
repair: Change the Audioscrobbler request default from HTTP to HTTPS.

selection.reason: The live audio project, exact failure response, current insecure default and absence of related PRs make this a bounded reproducible repair.

verification.limitations: BCL verifies the exact default endpoint before and after the repair. It does not submit credentials or scrobbles to the live Last.fm service.
verification.ownerCheck: Start audioscrobbler.submit with valid Last.fm credentials and confirm authorization no longer returns error code 4.
